name: Admin Menu Levels
description: Enhances the menu admin UI with a client-side depth filter and a hide-disabled-items toggle on menu edit pages.
project_description: Admin Menu Levels is a lightweight JavaScript-only helper that adds two extra controls to the menu administration edit pages (admin/structure/menu/manage/{menu_name}): a select list to choose how many menu-tree depth levels to display (One/Two/Three, inclusive, or All), and a checkbox to hide disabled menu items. The controls are added via hook_form_menu_edit_form_alter() and the filtering is performed entirely client-side by an attached jQuery behavior that shows/hides the menu-overview table rows; nothing is persisted to configuration. It helps administrators work with very long menus (such as the administration menu with hundreds of items) by narrowing the visible list. The project is not covered by the security advisory policy.
